const patch = "*** Begin Patch

@@
       - name: Verify all build targets succeeded
         run: |
           failed=""
           for result in \
             "${{ needs.build-tarball-linux.result }}" \
             "${{ needs.build-tarball-macos.result }}" \

*** End Patch";
